## Vanish Items on Command

Vanishes/poofs all items when a specific button combination is pressed simultaneously.

Buttons to press for each controller:

* Wii Wheel: A and Minus
* Nunchuk: C and D-Pad Down
* Classic Controller: ZL and Y
* GameCube Controller: Y and Z
